title: Concept: Content-Security-Policy base-uri allows every origin
description: The policy allowed any origin as the document base. A base element changes how every relative URL in the page resolves, so a single injection point - a comment, a stored name, a template parameter - can redirect script, style and form targets to another origin while the page's own markup stays unchanged.
applicability: HTML responses that carry a Content-Security-Policy.
risk: Relative-URL hijacking that bypasses other directives; MEDIUM severity.
